description:
Outcome: Operate the queue in a browser, from BRIEF.md.
Scope: Accessible add form, waiting/helped lists with repair item and anonymous reference, take-next/finish actions and integration; clear all operator lists/forms at server-provided day expiry even offline; no browser persistence. Excludes: public board and polling.
Acceptance: Successful add clears form; actions reflect server state; pending actions disabled; duplicates distinguishable; uncertain outcomes refresh before retry; current-day errors preserve input, day expiry clears name/item state and expired responses cannot restore it.
Behaviour: Labels, keyboard access, focus handling, loading/empty/error states and actionable validation.
Verification: Component and API workflow tests, disconnected rollover, cache/back-navigation and stale-response tests. Prerequisites: Q2 transitions. Assumptions: trusted LAN without sign-in; expiry applies to every operator view.
Setup label: Q3.
title: Volunteer and repairer controls
